tolerances_declared_before_results.scalar_parity: exact match to the published JW scalars

normalization: each feasibility constraint is divided by its own Euclidean norm; a projected norm below 1e-10 is reported as insensitive and is not turned into a unit vector
database_rule: individual database gradients are separate feasibility constraints and are not added again into JW

adamw.diagonal_convention: bias-corrected updated second moment preconditions the current gradient with no first-moment EMA; weight decay is kept; the vector is then rescaled to the exact AdamW norm for angle comparisons

finite_step_reference_norms.source: executed update_norm of the next logged AdamW step; t251 was not finite-stepped

finite_step_directions: negative F010 or F012 composite at that state
exact full-gradient AdamW of that state's own policy
B8 extended database-constrained direction at scale 1 only
